title: Baade Shabbir Hai
body:
asre ashoor hai aap ke shaah ka
zere khanjar gala
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala karbala karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
baade shabbir hai saani e khaafila
dasht mein berida
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm hadh se bada qaima qaima jala
sar chupaye kahan berida bibiyan
rota hai aasmaan
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
kya qayamat hai ye noke naiza pe hai
farse shaahe huda
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
muztarib hai behan khatm hai panjetan
aasman gir pada aa gaya zalzala
roti hai fatema
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
garm reti pa hai rab pa takiya kiye
aap ka laadla
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab wo anjaan thay sab musalman thay
sabr ki daastan kis tarha ho bayan
ruk rahi hai zaban
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
pani maanga kiye aur tadpa kiye
shaah e karbobala
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr e ashoor tha dushmano ke talay
saf se aage bade sheh ko ghayre rahe
teer o khanjar chale
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht ki khaak par jisme shabbir se
khoon behta raha
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm dekha kare kis se zainab kahe
dilbar e murtuza bhai shabbir ka
nehr par so raha
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
har taraf hai dhuan aap ka ghar jala
shola bhadka kiya
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi yawar nahi jal raha hai makaan
uth raha hai dhuan jaaye raandein kahan
hashr ka hai samaan
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hai bibiyan laasha abbas ka
nehr par hai pada
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki hai inteha roti hai karbala
haal e beemar par bibiyan nauhagar
naiza naiza hai sar
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
jaanib e shaam ab ek rasan mein bandha
jaata hai khaafila
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise mahir bayan gham ki ho daastan
berida hai haram sabki ankhein hai nam
gardane sabki kham
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
lab par zainab ke hai ay nabi e khuda
aaiye karbala
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
author: Mahir Lakhnavi
